## On Statistical Methods for Genetics: Fisher, Ewens and the Bayesian Programme

To prove, check or extend a result of this book, start with its catalog: each of the 58 results has its exact statement, its status (proved or open), its assumptions, its origin, its printed number and page, and the LaTeX file of its source. The numbers and pages are those of version 1.0.0 of the PDF. Cite the book and the number of the result.

- [On Statistical Methods for Genetics: Fisher, Ewens and the Bayesian Programme](https://vsokolov.org/books/statistical_methods_genetics/index.html.md): by Nicholas G. Polson (2026). Statistical theory of population genetics: an exact form of Fisher's Fundamental Theorem, shrinkage estimates of the rate of adaptation, the Ewens sampling formula and its rigidity, rational conjugacy, and sufficiency for learned coalescent inference. Keywords: population genetics, Fundamental Theorem of Natural Selection, Ewens sampling formula, Pitman Yor process, Poisson Dirichlet distribution, horseshoe prior, Pochhammer priors, Kingman coalescent, approximate Bayesian computation, sufficiency without a likelihood.

- [Main result: Whole genome Fundamental Theorem decomposition](https://vsokolov.org/books/statistical_methods_genetics/results.html#whole_genome): Theorem 3.5, page 66, proved. For arbitrary genotype frequency paths, the rate of change of mean Malthusian fitness splits exactly into an additive part and a remainder; the remainder vanishes whenever the log frequencies move inside the span of the gene contents, and it vanishes for every assignment of fitnesses only then.
- [Main result: Exact remainder for one locus with k alleles](https://vsokolov.org/books/statistical_methods_genetics/results.html#exact_remainder_one_locus_alleles): Theorem 3.16, page 76, proved. In the one locus random mating model with constant fitnesses, the change in mean fitness is the additive term divided by mean fitness plus an explicit quadratic remainder in the dominance deviations.
- [Main result: Oracle shrinkage understates the additive variance](https://vsokolov.org/books/statistical_methods_genetics/results.html#oracle_shrinkage_understates_the_additive_variance): Proposition 4.10, page 140, proved. Shrinkage tuned to estimate each average effect as well as possible necessarily understates the additive variance, by an explicit amount.
- [Main result: Shrinkage weights are stick breaking weights](https://vsokolov.org/books/statistical_methods_genetics/results.html#shrinkage_weights_are_stick_breaking_weights): Theorem 5.15, page 180, proved. The Beta law of the horseshoe type shrinkage weight is exactly the law of the first stick breaking weight of the two parameter GEM family, which links shrinkage priors to Ewens Pitman partitions.
- [Main result: Rigidity of the residual allocation structure](https://vsokolov.org/books/statistical_methods_genetics/results.html#py_thm_rigid): Theorem 7.11, page 271, proved. Among sampling densities that charge every interval, only power weights keep the induced subdivision of the size biased layout a residual allocation model, so for a discount strictly between zero and one no such density other than the uniform one carries a two parameter Poisson Dirichlet law to the stick breaking sequence of another member of the family.
- [Main result: A bottleneck that attains the Bayes risk is sufficient](https://vsokolov.org/books/statistical_methods_genetics/results.html#a_bottleneck_that_attains_the_bayes_risk_is_sufficient): Theorem 10.12, page 399, proved. If a learned map that factors through a summary of the data attains the minimal check loss, the summary is sufficient, so sufficiency can be tested by comparing risks.
- [Main result: The number of segregating sites is not sufficient for theta, likelihood argument](https://vsokolov.org/books/statistical_methods_genetics/results.html#is_not_sufficient_for): Proposition 11.12, page 443, proved. The conditional law of the infinite sites data given the site count depends on theta through the latent tree, shown explicitly for three and four sequences.
- [Main result: DeepSets encoders factor through the site frequency spectrum](https://vsokolov.org/books/statistical_methods_genetics/results.html#deepsets_encoders_factor_through_the_spectrum): Theorem 11.16, page 445, proved. Any encoder built from per site permutation invariant features depends on the data only through the site frequency spectrum, which caps what such an encoder can learn.
- [Open: Conjecture, rigidity of Poisson Dirichlet under general ascertainment](https://vsokolov.org/books/statistical_methods_genetics/results.html#future_conj_rigid): Conjecture 12.7, page 467
